host.description: On-chain UK property conveyancing. Sellers, buyers, conveyancers and estate agents share one transaction record on the Internet Computer; agents join a transaction by invite code and act through MCP tools.

entries.description: MCP server for reading and progressing UK property transactions: join by invite code, transaction state, checklists, document proofs, HM Land Registry and search intelligence, messaging. HTTP endpoint at https://mcp.propxchain.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1) or local stdio via npm @propxchain/mcp-server.
representativeQueries: what is outstanding on my house sale
verify this TA6 against the on-chain proof
summarise the Land Registry title for my purchase

entries.description: A2A agent card describing the PropXchain Conveyancer, its JSON-RPC interface at mcp.propxchain.com, OAuth2 security scheme and skills.
representativeQueries: find an agent that can track a UK property purchase

entries.description: Agent Skill: authenticate to PropXchain over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, discover endpoints via RFC 9728 and RFC 8414, handle tokens and errors.
representativeQueries: how do I authenticate an agent to PropXchain

entries.description: Agent Skill: work a UK sale or purchase on PropXchain through its MCP tools, with guard rails on money actions and personal data.
representativeQueries: walk me through my PropXchain sale
what should my conveyancer be doing next
